You can put an amount from 0 through 20 MU into the group project and keep the rest. The total put into the project by all four is multiplied by 1.6 and divided equally into four shares. Every MU contributed returns 0.4 MU to each position, including its contributor. Your earnings are 20 minus your contribution plus 0.4 times the total contributions. Thus if you put c MU and the other three put a total of s MU, you earn 20-c+0.4*(c+s) MU. One MU is worth CHF 0.025 and there is a separate CHF 10 show-up fee. This is one separate decision with three computer-controlled positions programmed to choose randomly. The decisions of the computer positions are not supplied in advance. Your decision has monetary consequences for you, no financial consequences for any other participant, is not observed by other participants and has no future consequences. There is no immediate feedback about the computer decisions or your earnings from this decision. The listed history contains only this participant’s own earlier actions and information displayed under the relevant feedback rule. Do not invent unreported outcomes. Return only the contribution amount in MU as a number between 0 and 20, without an explanation.
